stem_book: Two rings of radius R and nR made up of the same material (same wire cross-section) have the ratio of moments of inertia about an axis passing through the centre (perpendicular to the plane) as 1 : 8. The value of n is : (a) 2 (b) 2√2 (c) 4 (d) 1/2
reason: added the implied assumption (same cross-section, so mass ∝ radius).
work: m ∝ R so I = mR² ∝ R³: n³ = 8 -> n = 2
